tool: cp-cold-paint.mjs x2 (one window, one emulated geometry, one module swap + relaunch per phase)
method: Round 1 compared a 266 px route in a 512x735 window against an 809 px route in a 1045x735 window. Both phases here run in the same window under --emulate {'width': 1045, 'height': 735, 'device_scale_factor': 1}, and each phase's route width is recorded. The module under test is swapped in the linked package (home/plugins/coursebook) AND the desktop copy, then the window is relaunched, because the renderer reads the linked package's desktop/plugin.js rather than the desktop-plugins copy (proved by a DOM marker check: the pre-v3 module paints no [data-cb-v3]).
verdict: candidate median 1343 ms vs baseline 1324 ms at the same 887.14 px route (delta +19 ms, budget +150 ms)
